name: Outpaint
author: hearth-team
description: Extend an image beyond its original frame in one or more directions. Provide an image and a prompt for what should appear in the extended area. Routes through any installed provider that declares the outpaint capability (fal, Stability).

family.name: AI Image Family
family.description: Headshots, inpainting, wardrobe swap, logos, social posts. Pick a provider (OpenAI / KIE / Higgsfield / Replicate / fal / Stability / Recraft / Ideogram) and your favorite task — sub-skills route through whichever provider you've configured.
